references: StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf), topic: Local Anesthetic Infiltration
StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf), topic: Surgical Skin Preparation
todo: Every sequence is a teaching simplification of a hand skill: the moves, their order and their wording need a clinician's check.
Drawing back before injecting is included as it is commonly taught; whether to teach it for superficial infiltration is for review.
The number of wipes and flushes is arbitrary; the point being taught is outward wiping and a thorough flush.

moves.label: Lower the swab to the skin
moves.tip: Bring the sponge down until it rests on the skin.

moves.label: Wipe outward
moves.tip: Circle outward from the wound; never back over cleaned skin.

moves.label: Lift away
moves.tip: Take the swab off the skin.

faults.feedback: The swab is not on the skin yet. Lower it first.
Nothing has been cleaned yet. Wipe outward from the wound before lifting away.

infiltrate.title: Infiltrate local anaesthetic

moves.label: Angle the needle to the skin
moves.tip: Bevel up, at a shallow angle beside the wound edge.

moves.label: Advance the needle
moves.tip: Into the tissue beside the edge, not into the wound itself.

moves.label: Draw back
moves.tip: Pull the plunger back a little: blood in the barrel means a vessel.

moves.label: Press the plunger slowly
moves.tip: A slow, steady push raises a small bleb.

moves.label: Withdraw the needle
moves.tip: Straight back out along the line it went in.

faults.feedback: Angle the needle to the skin before advancing it.
The needle is not in the tissue yet.
Draw back on the plunger before injecting: blood coming back means the needle is in a vessel.
The needle is not in the tissue yet.

infiltrate.todo: Confirm whether to teach aspiration for superficial infiltration, and the bleb as the sign of a correct plane.

moves.label: Aim into the wound
moves.tip: Point the syringe into the wound bed, close to it.

moves.label: Flush
moves.tip: A firm push, so the stream carries debris out.

moves.label: Lift away
moves.tip: Take the syringe off the wound.

faults.feedback: Aim into the wound before flushing, or the saline goes everywhere but the wound.
The wound has not been flushed yet.

moves.label: Lower the forceps to the edge
moves.tip: Open jaws, either side of the skin edge.

moves.label: Close the jaws
moves.tip: The teeth take the dermis; the skin surface is not crushed.

moves.label: Lift the edge
moves.tip: Turn the edge outward to see the wound bed beneath it.

faults.feedback: The forceps are not at the edge yet.
The jaws are open: nothing is held.
